bullets.text: Public staged a road blockade near Periyapalayam over a five-hour power outage, disrupting traffic on the Chennai-Tirupati road for thirty minutes.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss urged Chief Minister Joseph Vijay to intervene directly in the alleged conspiracy to misappropriate the Pallikaranai marshland.
A mother and her illicit partner were arrested in Avadi, Tiruvallur district, following allegations of sexual harassment against a 15-year-old girl.
Tiruvallur district recorded 81 cases of vision loss due to firecrackers during the past Diwali festival, showing an increase compared to previous years.
Gummidipoondi fire and rescue department conducted a fire safety awareness program for students at the KLK Government Boys Higher Secondary School.
Tamil Nadu won three medals at the world para arm-wrestling championship in Ponneri, with nine players representing the national team in the global event.
ELCOT and IITM Pravartak signed an MoU at the Secretariat to establish a dedicated artificial intelligence data center for the Tamil Nadu government.
Asian stock benchmarks declined sharply after an artificial intelligence-related sell-off on Wall Street caused Japanese stocks to tumble by over six percent.
Artificial intelligence is increasingly impacting everyday life for millions of Indians through mobile phone applications across the country.
Kerala Law Academy Law College invited research papers for its 33rd international seminar focusing on good governance and artificial intelligence in the digital era.
